title: Digital Accessibility Compliance Standard
summary: Mandates WCAG AA compliance for all public-facing digital properties. Requires automated and manual accessibility auditing as a release-blocking criterion.

sections.heading: Standard
sections.body: All public-facing digital properties must conform to Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA.

sections.heading: Verification
sections.body: Automated accessibility scanning is required in CI/CD pipeline. Manual testing with screen readers and keyboard-only navigation required before production release.
